install.title: Installing the app
install.hint: Please keep this window open — the installation finishes automatically.
install.fallback: Could not reach Bitrix24. Close this window and start the installation again.

bad_request.title: Invalid request
bad_request.body: The app was opened with invalid parameters. Close this window and open the app from Bitrix24 again.

not_installed.title: The app is not installed yet
not_installed.body: Ask a Bitrix24 administrator to open the app once — the installation then completes automatically.

admin_only.title: Administrators only
admin_only.body: Only a Bitrix24 administrator can install and configure this app. Ask your administrator to open it.

unsupported_portal.title: This Bitrix24 is not supported
unsupported_portal.body: This Bitrix24 did not provide the data the app needs to authorise itself. Installing in this configuration is not supported yet — please contact the app's support.

method_missing.title: Call statistics are unavailable
method_missing.body: This Bitrix24 does not provide the call statistics method (voximplant.statistic.get). Enable Bitrix24 telephony or update the portal, then open the app again.

retry.title: Please try again
retry.body: Bitrix24 is not responding right now, or the request limit was reached. Close this window and open the app again in a minute.

scope.title: The app is missing permissions
scope.body: The app was not granted the access rights it needs. Reinstall it from the Bitrix24 Market and confirm the requested permissions.

denied.title: No access to call statistics
denied.body: Your account does not have access to call statistics. Ask your Bitrix24 administrator to grant the 'Call statistics — view' permission.

crm_no_access.title: No access to this CRM item
crm_no_access.body: You do not have permission to view this CRM item, so its calls are not shown. Please contact your Bitrix24 administrator.

reauth.title: Re-authorisation required
reauth.body: The app's authorisation has expired. Ask a Bitrix24 administrator to open the app — it re-authorises automatically.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: An unexpected error occurred. Close this window and open the app again. If it keeps happening, quote the request code to support.
